content: I don’t have enough information to determine whether “renewables alone can guarantee supply all winter” is true or false. Whether a standalone renewable system can provide reliable winter electricity depends on geography, existing storage/infrastructure, demand patterns, weather variability, grid connectivity, and technical assumptions in the claim. Without specifics (e.g., country/region, technology mix, backup provisions, storage capacity, demand details), it is impossible to verify the accuracy of the statement as it stands.
